payload.title: Build the model-neutral Decision Flywheel
payload.description: Deliver a small, auditable toolkit that improves decision alignment from trusted labels. First deliver the Decision Context Optimizer: fixed global context selection and target-conditioned retrieval, compared at explicit example and token budgets. Support Jev, Kev, and Laya through declared capabilities, then extract reusable feedback and learned-head mechanics from Jev-Flywheel. Dataset preparation and empirical claims belong in https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations; historical evidence remains in https://github.com/AnthusAI/Few-Shot-Jev. Completion requires reproducible optimizer artifacts, fake-client specs, a runnable offline example, and linked evaluation evidence. Creating this roadmap authorizes planning only; individual live studies retain their own preregistration and collection gates.
